facts.overview: In lyrical switches between the present and the past, Taeko contemplates the arc of her life, and wonders if she has been true to the dreams of her childhood self.
facts.title: Only Yesterday

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: As childhood memories steadily reemerge to mirror her adult choices, how will confronting her younger self reshape what she wants from her future?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Directed by Isao Takahata, this animated drama follows Taeko as she moves between her current adult life and vivid memories of her youth, questioning whether she has stayed true to the dreams of her childhood self.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, slow-paced, and gently emotional, demanding attentive solo viewing for its reflective drama.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Takahata crafts a patient, lyrical exploration of memory and personal growth, offering an animated drama that treats quiet reflection with warmth and delicate emotional weight.
